low_output.title: Low Solar Output
steps: Check the current weather and solar irradiance conditions.
Inspect the panel surface for dust, dirt, shading, or visible obstruction.
Check the inverter display for warnings or fault indicators.
Compare the current energy generation with the expected generation.
Inspect relevant cables and connections according to the approved site procedure.
Record the findings and escalate electrical faults to qualified personnel.

dirty_panel.title: Solar Panel Cleaning
steps: Follow the site's safety and isolation procedure.
Inspect the panel surface for dust, dirt, bird droppings, or other contamination.
Use the approved cleaning method and materials recommended by the manufacturer.
Clean the panel surface carefully.
Inspect the panel again after cleaning.
Record the maintenance activity.

inverter.title: Inverter Inspection
steps: Check the inverter display for error or warning messages.
Record the displayed error code.
Check whether the inverter is operating according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Inspect relevant external connections only according to the approved maintenance procedure.
Do not open or work inside electrical equipment unless authorized and qualified.
Escalate unresolved electrical faults to qualified personnel.

panel_inspection.title: Solar Panel Inspection
steps: Follow the site's safety procedure before inspection.
Visually inspect the panel for cracks or physical damage.
Check for shading or obstructions.
Look for signs of overheating or other visible abnormalities.
Record the panel location and observed condition.
Report significant damage according to the site's maintenance procedure.

general.title: General Solar Maintenance
steps: Check the current weather and operating conditions.
Inspect the solar panels for visible dirt, shading, or damage.
Check the inverter status and displayed warnings.
Review the system's recent energy production.
Record any abnormal observations.
Follow the manufacturer's and site's approved maintenance procedures.
